title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. ESTABLISH the A650 Speed Code Cards capital project with a Life-of-Project (LOP) budget in the amount of…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0671, Contract]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (5-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to:

A.	ESTABLISH the A650 Speed Code Cards capital project with a Life-of-Project (LOP) budget in the amount of $2,200,000;

B.	FIND that the purchase and installation of A650 Speed Code Cards under Public Utilities Code (PUC) Section 130237 constitutes a single source procurement method for the purpose of replacing equipment already in use; and

C.	AWARD a Sole Source five-month, firm-fixed price, Contract No. OP298873000, to QuEST Rail, LLC (QuEST) in the Not-To-Exceed (NTE) amount of $1,499,850 for the purchase and installation of Speed Code Cards to the A650 fleet comprised of 98 cars, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any.

(REQUIRES TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE FULL BOARD)
